scares.description: A boar chases Gary and Denise.
A baby snake bites Warren’s thumb.
The Anaconda appears in front of Mateo.
Something grabs onto the bait in the water.
The Anaconda emerges from the water screaming.
The Anaconda rears up in front of Gary and grabs him.
The Anaconda breaks through a wall behind Terri.
The Anazconda bursts through a wooden dock that Terri is sitting on.
